newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil weakens.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil weakens.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight run fuel was weak on Thursday, despite stronger crude futures, with few local buyers in the market.
One refiner was offering 0.6 percent sulphur material at $108 fob but found no takers. Bids heard in the market were as low as $101 from U.S. buyers.
"Its a supply blip at the moment," said one trader. "We're not in yet but we could potentially be in to take advantage of the market."
High sulphur straight run markets were still seen very well supplied by Russian material.
